_about: Community goals (Shared/community/CommunityData.cs reads this; the world server's CommunityGoals counts them; tools/wiki_community.py builds the wiki's Community Goals page from it).

Each week (Monday 00:00 UTC) 'slots' goals are drawn from 'goals', one per 'group', the groups in turn so each comes back only after the others; 'weight' picks between a group's goals. The week's draw is kept in Redis when it starts, so changes here only change the weeks to come.

A goal: 'event' what counts and 'filter' what narrows it (as in quests.json), 'goal' the whole server's target, 'minimum' what an account must add to share the rewards, 'icon' an object id the window shows. A kill, a dungeon cleared, a realm closed or an Arena wave counts once towards the total however many share it, and once for each of them.

Tiers: reached at 'tierShares' of the goal and named 'tierNames'. Every account past the minimum claims each tier reached, from the Warcaller by the Nexus spawn; the top 'topCount' contributors claim the 'top' prize too once the goal ends. A goal without 'tiers' or 'top' gives 'defaultTiers' and 'defaultTop'.
Rewards: {"fame": n} to the account, {"item": "<id>", "count": n} to the gift chest in the vault. They stay claimable 'claimWeeks' weeks after a goal ends.
Specials: goals with 'from' and 'until' (UTC days, yyyy-MM-dd, both included) run besides the week's. Give each a new id.
